edges.reason: initialize grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and ADMIN_ROLE to _msgSender(), making msg.sender the initial privileged account
pause() requires hasRole(ADMIN_ROLE, _msgSender()), so the caller identity is the authorization gate
unpause() requires hasRole(ADMIN_ROLE, _msgSender()), so the caller identity is the authorization gate
transferERCToken() requires hasRole(ADMIN_ROLE, _msgSender()) before moving arbitrary ERC20 tokens
msg.sender is forwarded as the sender argument into the untrusted recipient tokenFallback callback
grantRole checks hasRole(adminRole, _msgSender()) before granting any role
burn() burns from _msgSender(), tying the destroyed balance to the caller
permit() compares block.timestamp to the deadline, creating timestamp-dependent authorization
User-supplied deadline participates in the signature struct and expiry check
ADMIN_ROLE constant controls the pause authorization check
ADMIN_ROLE constant controls the unpause authorization check
ADMIN_ROLE constant controls the transferERCToken authorization check
hasRole resolves membership through the _roles state mapping
hasRole resolves membership through the _roles state mapping
grantRole reads and writes role membership and admin data in _roles
initialize assigns DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE as the root privilege to the deployer
DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE administers all roles including ADMIN_ROLE, enabling grantRole escalation
transferAndCall performs an external call to the recipient's tokenFallback after transfer, enabling reentrant control flow
The recipient callback returns control to transferAndCall while state is already updated
transferAndCall invokes the public transfer function to move tokens
transferERCToken externally calls transfer on a caller-supplied token contract, allowing callback reentrancy
The arbitrary ERC20 transfer returns control to transferERCToken during execution
_delegate performs a full-gas delegatecall to the implementation address
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls arbitrary data into a newly set implementation
Caller-supplied newImplementation is written to the proxy implementation slot
Caller-supplied data is used verbatim as delegatecall calldata
transfer delegates state mutation to the internal _transfer routine
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances
_beforeTokenTransfer reads the _paused flag to block transfers while paused
_transfer debits and credits the _balances mapping
_transfer indirectly relies on allowance-consistent accounting used by transferFrom
_mint increases _totalSupply via SafeMath
_mint credits the target address in _balances
initialize mints the fixed initial supply to the provided address
initialize grants ADMIN_ROLE to the deployer
initialize grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to the deployer
initialize receives the mint recipient parameter
The recipient parameter flows into _mint as the credited account
_burn debits the account balance in _balances
_burn reduces _totalSupply
burn routes the caller's tokens into the internal _burn routine
burnFrom burns from the account after reducing the caller's allowance
burnFrom computes decreasedAllowance from the current allowance
burnFrom rewrites _allowances with the decreased value
The decreased allowance is approved before the burn amount is destroyed
_pause sets _paused to true
_unpause sets _paused to false
pause calls the internal _pause after the admin check
unpause calls the internal _unpause after the admin check
permit stores the ECDSA-recovered signer into the signer local
The recovered signer must equal owner for permit to proceed
permit owner parameter is hashed and compared with the recovered signer
permit spender parameter is hashed and later granted the allowance
permit value parameter is hashed and set as the new allowance
permit finally calls _approve to set owner's allowance for spender
_approve writes the nested _allowances mapping
tokenContractAddress parameter selects the externally called token contract
to parameter is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer
amount parameter is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer
recipient parameter determines both transfer target and callback target
amount parameter is transferred and passed into tokenFallback
data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the tokenFallback callback

normalization_plan.reason: The initialize 'to' parameter only exists to feed the initializer's mint call and can be folded into the initialize function node
tokenContractAddress is a direct argument of the admin-only transferERCToken external call and merges into that function node
The transferERCToken recipient parameter is consumed only by the external token transfer in that function
The transferERCToken amount parameter is consumed only by the external token transfer in that function
recipient is the caller-controlled address that triggers the tokenFallback callback and belongs to transferAndCall
amount is only used to size the transfer performed inside transferAndCall
data is only forwarded into the external callback performed by transferAndCall
owner is the signed authorization subject of permit and normalizes into that function
spender is the allowance grantee of permit and normalizes into that function
value is the allowance amount set by permit and normalizes into that function
deadline participates in the timestamp-dependent permit authorization check and merges into permit
newImplementation is written into the proxy slot by upgradeToAndCall and merges into that function
data is delegatecalled by upgradeToAndCall and merges into that function
The recovered signer local is only validated inside permit against the owner, so it folds into permit
decreasedAllowance is an intermediate computation local to burnFrom and merges into that function
